notes.title: The Soundtrack Is Here!
notes.content:
I am happy to announce the Quiver Quest Soundtrack is live : )

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45151348/4c5dd3dc3e415de10db45bcd7b7e85962c0a5139.jpg[/img]

Includes eight tracks in mp3 format.


[list]
[*] Quiver Quest
[*] Ocean Blue
[*] Sanz Variation One
[*] Sea Song
[*] Quiver Quest (Secondary Theme)
[*] Bells
[*] Summer Harvest
[*] Mountain Run
[/list]

Check it out here : [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3297970/Quiver_Quest_Soundtrack/]Quiver Quest Soundtrack[/url]
